title_en: LOWE'S Profesyonel Pore Tightening & Purifying Toner 250 ml
ingredients_inci: LOWE'S -profesyonel- PURPOSE OF USAGE Aims to remove excess oil, dead skin cells, dirt, and makeup residue from the skin. Also helps tighten pores, even out skin tone, and balance sebum production. Suitable for all skin types. KULLANIM AMACI Cildi fazla yağdan, ölü cilt hücrelerinden, kir ve makyaj kalıntılarından arındırmayı hedefler. Aynı zamanda; gözeneklerin sıkılaşmasına, cilt tonunun eşitlenmesine ve sebum üretimini dengelemeye yardımcı olur. Tüm cilt tipleri için uygundur. . . Aqua, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Propylene Glycol, Polysorbate 20, Alcohol Denat., Chamomilla Recutita Flower Extract, Salicylic Acid, Parfum, Glycolic Acid, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Benzyl Salicylate, Hexyl Cinnamal, Terpineol, CI 42090. PORE TIGHTENING & PURIFYING TONER GÖZENEK SIKILAŞTIRICI & ARINDIRICI TONİK Helps Purify and Tighten Pores
directions: Pour a few drops onto a cotton pad and gently apply to your clean face and neck. No rinsing necessary. Recommended for use 2-3 times per week at night.
purpose_from_pack: Aims to remove excess oil, dead skin cells, dirt, and makeup residue from the skin. Also helps tighten pores, even out skin tone, and balance sebum production. Suitable for all skin types.
warnings: For External Use Only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse with plenty of water.
